title: Machine learning screens non-ionic deep eutectic solvents for CO2 capture
summary: Random forest and support vector regression models using COSMO-RS descriptors were compared, with SVR performing best and generalizing under leave-one-DES-out validation. Virtual screening of 1051 candidates identified three imidazole/ethylene glycol solvents, which were measured experimentally with Henry's law constants of 8.53-10.02 MPa at 303.15 K. A transfer-learning step was also applied to SO2 solubility.
ai_technology: Support vector regression and random forest on COSMO-RS descriptors for virtual solvent screening
